subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical Google Chat Space @mention ingress bug pending live v2026.6.11+ proof, or should maintainers consolidate the remaining evidence into another Google Chat Space routing item before implementation?
rationale: The merged classifier fix is shipped and useful, but current source still has a mention-gate drop path and the latest live report points at annotation matching; choosing the next implementation target needs maintainer acceptance of the live-proof and consolidation bar.

options.title: Keep Canonical Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open, request a redacted live Space @mention payload/probe run, and fix the plugin mention-detection path once the real annotation shape is confirmed.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining evidence into a broader Google Chat Space/thread routing item only if maintainers want one canonical Space reliability tracker.

options.title: Treat Workaround As Sufficient
options.body: Document `requireMention:false` for affected Spaces as the supported workaround and close only if maintainers decide @mention detection does not need a product fix.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, request a redacted live Space @mention payload/probe run, and fix the plugin mention-detection path once the real annotation shape is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on Google Chat access policy and shared mention-gating code, which is the decision surface for the remaining failure.
